'''Haitian Vodoun Culture Language''' (known as '''{{lang|hvc|Langay}}''' and '''{{lang|hvc|Langaj}}'''; literally "language") is a specialized vocabulary used in [[Haiti]] for religion, song, and dance purposes. It appears to not be an actual language, but rather an assortment of words, songs, and incantations – some secret – from various languages once used in [[Haitian Vodoun]] ceremonies.<ref name="e18" />
